reason: I paid an agency before and got nothing, so EUR 1,500 up front still feels like a bet. I might take the free 15-company list, but my partner would have to sign off and that won't happen this month on the strength of one call.
objection: The '45 meetings in 2 months' sounds like every agency pitch I've heard. Meetings are easy to count. Meetings with people who actually move freight with us are not, and I can't tell from this which one they mean.
would_change_my_mind: A real conversation with that past logistics client about how many of those meetings turned into contracts, plus a free 15-company list good enough that I could show it to my partner.
